command_adapter_path.description: Actual source-owner-published PUBLIC command adapter prefix, including legitimate reverse-proxy public prefix. Core signs exactly this public target.

signature_target_prefix.description: Optional fixed source-owned proxy public/internal target mapping; never changes the Core signed public request target and never comes from request headers.

owner_action_service.description: Actual source-owner frontend service, independent of callback/API listener.

owner_action_base_path.description: Optional fixed owner frontend path prefix; default empty origin. No callback-path inference.

$comment: Manifest owner_journeys and native capability_proofs are acceptance prerequisites per relevant scenario, not readiness declarations. Exact source+script digests are checked by the actual runner; factory recomputes source digest for diagnostics.
